Atari’s first-ever video game has persisted to become the company’s longest-running franchise and one of only two gaming franchises to remain active for over 50 years. The iconic table tennis-inspired game was among the first arcade games ever released. It’s considered the first commercially successful video game, and as such, is regarded as a catalyst for the video game industry at large.
